notes.note: Speaker verified in Quest001 script: W (Shotaro), shown if W is in the party (TextIdOffset+183); otherwise the leader variant 185-198 plays. 'This wind' = Metron's plan to spread the red-crystal smoke on the Cube's wind; Shotaro is from Fuuto, the windy city.

Leader-variant order from the script's branch chain (k = 0..13): Seven, 00, Ultraman, Taro, Mebius, Zero, Rider 1, Black RX, Den-O (Momotaros), OOO, Nu, Zeta, God, Wing Zero -> rows 185-198. Not the usual 11-15,1-10 order. 186 is Setsuna's distortion line; 193 Momotaros; 190 Zero.
System message; matches QuestMess wording 'Obtained "Smooth Hide".'

Not referenced by Quest002 event script (only progress rows 3-12 and OkWin rows are); speaker inferred as Birth, the quest client (repairs items, researches medals). Japanese says 10 Cell Medals although the quest asks for 100; translated as written.
Item handover location not stated (literally 'left in deposit'); rendered 'left ... for you'.
Speaker '???' (CHARA_NAME 30) - Woo before it is identified.

Quest003 variants keyed by which Ultra is in the party: Ultraman 6-8/28/36/43-44, Seven 10-12/29/37/45-46, Taro 14-16/30/38/47-48, Mebius 18-20/31/39/49-50, Zero 22-24/32/40/51-52 (verified from branch offsets 0/4/8/12/16, txt2 0-4, 0/2/4/6/8). 'Legendary Monster Woo' follows the official epithet style (cf. 'Ancient Monster Gomora'); name Woo from CharacterName.
The script's second Woo line points at the same text as row 27 (the roar); this groan row appears unused by the event. Translated anyway.
Zero's 'aitsu' for Woo rendered 'that thing' (Woo is a creature; no gender assumed).
Source is the {F000} tag plus one full-width space; English keeps the tag only.
Speaker verified in Quest004 script: Maganac (CHARA_NAME 79).

report: All 80 rows translated. Speakers verified against Quest001/003/004 event scripts (slice had no speaker labels). Quest001 185-198 leader order differs from the usual order (see note). Quest002 rows 15/18-20 not referenced by the event script; Birth inferred, and row 18 says 10 medals vs 100 in the quest text. Quest003 row 41 appears unused. No new names.
